title: Amendment of the Order of Establishment of Criminal Court for Darfur’s Events (November 2005)
text:
Amendment of the Order of Establishment of Criminal Court for Darfur’s
Incidents
The Chief Justice:
Having taken advice of the Order of Establishment of Criminal Court for Darfur’s
Incidents issued on the 7th of June 2005,
I hereby issue the following Order:
The Order shall be amended as follows:
First: Sub-section 5.a, the following phrase shall be added:
“and the international humanitarian law”.
Second: In Para 8. the following item shall be added:
“Observers from the AU or any other entity may attend the Court’s sessions to
follow the Court’s procedures.”
Third: This amendment shall enter into force as from the date of signing.
Issued under my signature this day the 10th of November 2005.
Jalal Al-Din Mohamed Osman
Chief Justice
Translated by Suhaila Mohamed. 1
Translation & Interpretation Unit.
UNMIS
